text:
mai: quick mobile check-in — on very narrow screens the left rail peek causes the main list to jump horizontally. repro: scroll right on table, swipe to reveal rail, content snaps.

evan: saw it. suspect we toggle width which forces layout. recommend animating via transform + will-change to keep compositing. also add `overflow-anchor: none` to the scroll container to stop anchor jumps.

toni: UX trade: overlay rail vs bottom sheet. overlay keeps list visible but eats screen real estate; bottom sheet is discoverable with edge-swipe but hides action chips. leaning overlay that doesn't push content.

aria-bot: accessibility findings: focus trapping missing when rail opens; small icon-only buttons under 44px. rule refs: A11Y-focus-1, WCAG-touchsize-2.

leo: copy nit on compact rows: `Details` -> `View` felt shorter but ambiguous. propose `Open` for action verbs on tiny buttons.

mai: plan: 1) evan implement transform animation + overflow-anchor change; 2) toni prototype overlay with focus trap; 3) leo help decide microcopy; aria-bot will re-scan after changes. back in PR review tomorrow. thanks :sparkles:
